method.profiles: Fresh isolated APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA directories, no signed-in session
method.execution: Extracted MSI to a task-specific temporary directory and ran without installing
method.processState: Cold application process; Windows disk cache was not flushed
method.firstWindowDefinition: First Telumia main window with a non-zero Win32 handle and title
method.processTreeSample: Five seconds after first window; process descendants were attributed while Telumia roots were still alive
method.aggregateMemoryCaveat: Summed process working set can count shared pages more than once; private memory is reported separately
method.idleCpuAndUiProbe: CPU over a five-second idle interval; WM_NULL sent every 250 ms. Does not measure Compose interaction, frame cadence, or playback

baselineArtifact.windowsBehavior: Hidden WebView2 warmup runs during startup

candidateArtifact.execution: Extracted to a temporary directory for inspection; not installed
candidateArtifact.windowsBehavior: JNI library initializes on startup; hidden WebView2 warmup is deferred until the real player surface opens; Linux WebKitGTK warmup is preserved

historicalProcessOnlySeries.scope: Earlier report summed Telumia.exe processes only and omitted WebView2 helper processes; do not compare its memory figures with the full-tree measurements above

isolatedStartupOutlier.memoryInvalidReason: Launcher exited before tree aggregation and Windows reused its PID, so unrelated descendant processes were included
isolatedStartupOutlier.note: Observed on an intermediate package with the same Windows no-warmup behavior; repeat before drawing a startup conclusion

limitations: The Windows candidate does not measure latency of the first real player surface or playback stability.
WM_NULL idle probes do not measure Compose interaction, frame pacing, jank, focus response, or freezes under load.
The isolated 6915 ms startup observation remains an outlier and should be repeated.
This increment changed only Desktop; no APK was rebuilt or benchmarked in this delivery.
Prior Android AVD measurements did not show a conclusive startup improvement and do not replace testing on a physical ARM TV Box with 2 GiB RAM.
The combined PC/APK performance gate and Phase 1-A remain open.
